title: Night Walker — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 1400/1410/1411/1412/1414; WZ API for V/HEXA)

skills.name: Haste
skills.description: Permanently increases Speed, Jump, Max Speed, and Avoidability.

skills.name: Lucky Seven
skills.description: Throw 7 lucky throwing stars to attack enemies in front.

skills.name: Dark Elemental
skills.description: Channels the power of a dark elemental. Using the skill briefly summons the elemental.

skills.name: Dark Sight
skills.description: Hide in the shadows for a short time. While Dark Sight is active, you cannot be hit by enemies, but attacking will reveal you. The cooldown will change when Dark Sight is deactivated, depending on damage dodged. Using Shadow Jump does not deactivate Dark Sight. Press the skill key again to deactivate Dark Sight.

skills.name: Shadow Dodge
skills.description:
Quickly move backwards.
You can move in the air and during the last attack of throwing skills, and cannot be pushed back when moving. If you've learned Dark Sight and used it during the last attack of a throwing skill, Dark Sight will be activated automatically for a short time.
SP is not required for this skill, and it can be used upon job advancing to Night Walker.

skills.name: Shadow Jump
skills.description:
Use while in the middle of a jump to jump twice in a row. Can also be used with the Jump Key. Also, the last attack of throwing skills can be canceled with the Jump Key. If you've learned Dark Sight and used the Jump Key during the last attack of a throwing skill, Dark Sight will be activated automatically for a short time.
With Action Customization enabled, hold the right or left arrow key while pressing the skill key to jump in the corresponding direction, otherwise you will jump in place.
SP is not required for this skill, and it can be used upon job advancing to Night Walker.
Action Customization On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Shadow Bat
skills.description:
Summons a Shadow Bat, which occasionally attacks when you do. Its attack rate is doubled against enemies marked with Darkness, and as many summoned bats attack as there are marks. Then summons 1 additional Shadow Bat.
Unaffected by attack reflection. Cannot be used at the same time as Ravenous Bat. This is a dark-attribute attack.
This skill can be toggled on/off by using the skill key.

skills.name: Dark Sight
skills.description: Hide in the shadows for a short time. You cannot be hit by enemies, but using the skill will reveal you.

skills.name: Soundless Rush
skills.description: Charges the enemy without making a sound.

skills.name: Agile Throwing
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Luck.

skills.name: Throwing Mastery
skills.description: Increases Claw Mastery, Damage, and the max number of charges.

skills.name: Critical Throw
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently improves LUK through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Adaptive Darkness
skills.description: Enhances your Marks of Darkness by immersing your soul in even deeper darkness.

skills.name: Bat Affinity
skills.description: Enhances the Shadow Bat through communion.

skills.name: Triple Throw
skills.description:
[Throw]
Throws 3 Throwing Stars in a row at the target. The last attack uses the power of Darkness to deal greater dark-attribute damage. The throwing stars attack the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Shadow Spark
skills.description: Throws penetrating Throwing Stars imbued with the power of darkness. The stars explode when they are either at max range or all attackable enemies are attacked, dealing extra damage. It's a dark-attribute attack.

skills.name: Enveloping Darkness
skills.description: Cloak yourself in darkness, increasing Status Resistance, Elemental Resistance, and Knockback Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Alchemic Adrenaline
skills.description: Increases the effect of recovery items like potions. Does not work on percentage-based recovery items like elixirs. Also increases Critical Damage.

skills.name: Adaptive Darkness II
skills.description: Enhances your Marks of Darkness by immersing your soul in even deeper darkness.

skills.name: Bat Affinity II
skills.description: Enhances the Shadow Bat through communion. Summons enhanced Shadow Bats to deal explosion damage, depending on the number of summoned Shadow Bats. The enhanced Shadow Bats are not enhanced by Bat Affinity or Bat Affinity II, and are unaffected by attack reflection. The enhanced Shadow Bats deal dark-attribute attacks.

skills.name: Spirit Projection
skills.description:
Allows you to attack without consuming Throwing Stars, and increases Attack Power.
The first Throwing Star in your inventory will be used to calculate your damage. Throwing Star skills cannot be used if there are no Throwing Stars in your inventory.

skills.name: Shadow Momentum
skills.description:
Gives the attack inertia to use throwing skills even faster, and increases Final Damage permanently. The last attack can be canceled when using throwing skills consecutively.
Right-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Quad Star
skills.description:
[Throw]
Throws 4 Throwing Stars in a row at the target. The last attack uses the power of Darkness to deal greater dark-attribute damage. The throwing stars attack the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Dark Servant
skills.description: Summons shadows that copy your actions after a short delay. The copied actions are limited to throwing stars and movement skills. Your shadows disappear when the summon duration runs out. The shadows deal dark-attribute attacks and can activate Marks of Darkness, Shadow Bats, or Ravenous Bats without being affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Darkness Ascending
skills.description:
When hit by a fatal attack, the power of darkness will restore you back to life.
Not affected by Cooldown reset.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Throwing Expert
skills.description: Increases Claw Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Dark Blessing
skills.description: The power of darkness fills you, increases your stats.

skills.name: Adaptive Darkness III
skills.description: Enhances your Marks of Darkness by immersing your soul in even deeper darkness. Does not apply Combat Orders.

skills.name: Bat Affinity III
skills.description: Enhances the Shadow Bat through communion. Summons an enhanced Ravenous Bat that deal powerful damage, depending on the number of summoned Ravenous Bats. The enhanced Ravenous Bats are not enhanced by Bat Affinity, Bat Affinity II, or Bat Affinity III, and target the boss with the highest HP first. The enhanced Ravenous Bats deal dark-attribute attacks that are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Vitality Siphon
skills.description: Absorbs liveliness from your enemies to create a protective shield for yourself while you set your Mark of Darkness. Protective Shield will not be affected by buff duration increase.

skills.name: Shadow Slip
skills.description: Chance to melt into the shadows, avoid enemy attacks, and decrease damage taken.

skills.name: Vitality Siphon
skills.description: You created a protective shield for yourself using liveliness you absorbed from your enemies.

skills.name: Quintuple Star - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Quintuple Star damage.

skills.name: Quintuple Star - Boss Rush
skills.description: Damage increases when attacking Boss Monsters with Quintuple Star.

skills.name: Quintuple Star - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases the Critical Rate of Quintuple Star.

skills.name: Dark Omen - Cooldown Cutter
skills.description: Reduces Dark Omen's cooldown.

skills.name: Dark Omen - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Dark Omen.

skills.name: Dark Omen - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Dark Omen.

skills.name: Vitality Siphon - Extra Point
skills.description: Increases the Protective Shield created with the Vitality Siphon.

skills.name: Vitality Siphon - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the Attack Power when a Protective Shield created with Vitality Siphon exists.

skills.name: Vitality Siphon - Preparation
skills.description: Increases the Status Resistance when a Protective Shield created with Vitality Siphon exists.

skills.name: Call of Cygnus
skills.description: The Empress's blessing increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Empress appear.

skills.name: Quintuple Star
skills.description:
[Throw]
Throws 5 Throwing Stars in a row at the target. The last attack uses the power of Darkness to deal greater dark-attribute damage. The throwing stars attack the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Dark Omen
skills.description:
Summons a pack of bats to attack enemies. If used while Shadow Bat is active, summons a weakened pack of bats for a longer period of time.
Shadow Bats and Ravenous Bats are summoned for every enemy hit. Unaffected by enemy damage reflection skills and cannot be pushed back when casting. This is a dark-attribute attack.

skills.name: Shadow Stitch
skills.description: Detonates condensed shadows to lock nearby enemies. Increases incapacitation in proportion to the condensed duration. Cannot be pushed back when condensing shadows. Unaffected by attack reflection. It's a dark-attribute attack.

skills.name: Dark Omen
skills.description:
Summons a pack of bats to attack enemies. If used while Shadow Bat is active, summons a weakened pack of bats for a longer period of time.
Shadow Bats and Ravenous Bats are summoned for every enemy hit. Unaffected by enemy damage reflection skills and cannot be pushed back when casting. This is a dark-attribute attack.

skills.name: Dark Evasion
skills.description:
Use the power of the dark element to negate an enemy's attack for a set duration. The skill can be canceled by using it again.
Not affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Cygnus Knights' Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Ravenous Bat
skills.description:
Summons a Ravenous Bat thirsting for more blood, which occasionally attacks when you do. As many summoned bats attack as there are enemies marked with Darkness. Then summons 1 additional Ravenous Bat. The Ravenous Bats target the boss with the highest HP first and are unaffected by attack reflection. Cannot be used at the same time as Shadow Bat. The bats deal dark-attribute attacks.
This skill can be toggled on/off by using the skill key.

skills.description:

skills.name: Dominion
skills.description:
Unleashes the power of darkness, creating an area of supernatural force around you. It's a dark-attribute attack.
Right-click to toggle the gray background ON/OFF

skills.name: Glory of the Guardians
skills.description: A ceremony for Cygnus Knights to pledge their devotion to the Empress.

skills.name: Shadow Illusion
skills.description: Summons 3 shadows that copy your actions after a short delay. The copied actions are limited to throwing stars and movement skills. Your shadows disappear when the summon duration runs out. The shadows deal dark-attribute attacks and can activate Marks of Darkness, Shadow Bats, or Ravenous Bats without being affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Shadow Spear
skills.description: Shadows coalesce form a spear that pierces enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Has no effect in towns. This is a dark-attribute attack.

skills.name: Greater Dark Servant
skills.description: Summon a shadow that mimics its summoner.

skills.name: Shadow Bite
skills.description: Makes your enemies' shadows attack them. If Shadow Bat and Ravenous Bat can be summoned, the bats appear and immediately attack the enemies. The bats summoned by Shadow Bat aren't enhanced. This is a dark-attribute attack. Permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: HEXA Quintuple Star

Throws 5 Throwing Stars in a row at the target. The last attack uses the power of Darkness to deal greater dark-attribute damage, and is enhanced to Jet Black Throwing Stars at regular intervals. These throwing stars fly a longer distance, attack all enemies along the way, and deal greater dark-attribute damage.
The throwing stars target the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Silence
skills.description:
With the power of infinite darkness, calls forth the Shadow Bat to silence enemies with fear.
For a certain period of time, when the attack hits, the Shadow Bat morphs into huge Shadow Throwing Stars, continuously targeting and attacking the enemy. The Shadow Throwing Stars trigger Dark Elemental, Shadow Bat, and Ravenous Bat effects with each attack.
The Shadow Throwing Stars target the boss with the highest max HP first. Unaffected by attack reflection.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30%, Boss Damage +30%
